#                         lateral grid at each native depth level. This is the
#                         same reduction used for every radial validation in
#                         this study (unified mantle validation
#                         convergence
#                         It is NOT a near-side or far-side extraction.
#   extracted_on        : 2026-08-24
# COORDINATE
#   depth_km is depth BELOW THE LUNAR SURFACE
#   source field. Radius is deliberately NOT tabulated here: the Santangelo
#   model uses a 1740 km outer radius while this project's PlanetProfile body
#   uses R = 1737.15 km (Neumann 2013). Prescribing against depth anchors the
#   profile to the surface thermal boundary condition
#   ~2.85 km offset that a radius-based mapping would introduce.
# COVERAGE AND LIMITS
#   levels              : 91
#   depth range         : 0.0 to 1350.0 km
#   surface value       : 250.00 K -- consistent with the 250 K surface
#                         boundary condition adopted independently in PPLuna
#                         (Laneuville et al. 2013).
#   CRUST               : COVERED. The field spans 0-40 km
#                         not require a separate thermal bridge.
#   DEEP LIMIT          : the field STOPS at 1350 km depth
#                         It does NOT reach a plausible lunar CMB (Weber et al.
#                         Any mantle node deeper than this has NO prescribed
#                         temperature and must not be silently extrapolated.
# This file is a derived extraction. The original source data is unmodified.
